Max H: Hey finance — I registered for HelmCon (EUR 1,200) on my personal card because the corp card got declined. I uploaded the vendor PDF but it looks like a generic receipt, no VAT number. Can I get reimbursed and can we reclaim VAT? Also need the charge split 70% infra / 30% research. Link to upload: https://ramp.mock/receipts/1879450123.pdf

Lara (Finance): Thanks — please upload the PDF to Ramp and select EUR as the currency. We'll reimburse the full gross amount. For VAT reclaim we need a supplier VAT number and an invoice that shows VAT broken out. If vendor can provide that, we can attempt reclaim. Otherwise we can't recover VAT. Also include the bank txn screenshot.

Tom (Card Ops): Hi Max — MCC 7999 (events) can sometimes be blocked by the merchant category policy. If you DM me the merchant name and txn id I can whitelist this merchant for the team. In the meantime finance can reimburse.

Priya (Manager): Approved. @Lara please mark as manager-approved for project split 70/30. Max — tag the expense with PROJECT:INFRA and PROJECT:RND.

Lara (Finance): To split in Ramp do: "Split expense" -> add two line items. Example amounts: 840 EUR (70%) code INFRA, 360 EUR (30%) code RND. Add a note: "HelmCon registration — Priya approved". For exchange rate, use the transaction date's market rate; we usually accept Google/ECB daily rate. If you want, paste the exchange rate you used and we'll verify.

expense-bot: :warning: Missing field: vendor VAT number. Please upload updated invoice if available.

Max H: Uploaded the receipt + bank txn screenshot just now. Vendor email billing@helmcon.eu — they replied saying they don't issue VAT invoices because they're a small event organizer in the EU. They said "VAT included" on the receipt but no VAT number.

Lara (Finance): Okay. If vendor cannot provide a VAT invoice with VAT number we cannot reclaim. We'll reimburse the gross and code it to the two projects. Fiscal note: finance will log this as non-reclaimable VAT and expense will be recorded to the project's gross cost. If this matters for your budget planning, let me know and we can post a transfer to operating expense.

Tom (Card Ops): Merchant whitelisted for future transactions from Redwood cards. You should be able to re-run on corp card next time. If you see another decline, DM me the exact timestamp and last 4 of the ticketed card txn and I'll trace.

Lara (Finance): Quick copy of how to fill the split (paste into Ramp description if helpful):

```
Line 1: 840.00 EUR — PROJECT:INFRA — Manager: Priya — Notes: HelmCon registration (70%)
Line 2: 360.00 EUR — PROJECT:RND — Manager: Priya — Notes: HelmCon registration (30%)
Exchange rate used: 1 EUR = [paste rate] -> total USD equivalent
Attachments: vendor_receipt.pdf, bank_txn.png
```

Lara (Finance): Once the Ramp expense is submitted and approved by Priya we'll process reimbursement in the next payroll run (or via ACH if marked expedited). Marking as pending reimbursement.

Max H: Thanks all — uploaded and flagged Priya for approval. Appreciate the whitelist, Tom. :thumbsup:

Priya (Manager): Approved in Ramp.

Lara (Finance): Got it — reimbursing gross and marking VAT as non-reclaimable. Closing thread once payment posts. :white_check_mark:
